answers.core: This is about improving the ui node's usability out of the box.
answers.workaround:
I am finding it very difficult to work around. To get the text box sizes I want, I feel I have to forgo using any containers that lay out nodes in any way.
The only (bad) solutions I have found so far, are to make the text have no StyleBox; and then use separate nodes to display the graphics for the text box, and then lay them all out manually.

title: Allow Customization of Leading and Descent Metrics for Single Line Text Boxes like LineEdit
